title: Batch 49.4 (47.8 reduced) on the 27B (L32; every 8th layer L8-L56 plus L30, L32, L34 (9 layers)): layer anatomy of the switch. Routes scenes (another item moved; the sanity swap), locker-first, split by bridge entity into a fit half and a test half; per layer the J++ / address (U_l) / identity-outside-J++ (I_l) parts of the bridge word's change, keep-only and without arms each against a random part of the same share, both readers, the probes and the refits; the D4 cache; SEALED until Q47.8
command: export BJ_TARGET=qwen3.6-27b BJ_DEVICE_MAP=; uv run python scripts/x47_anatomy.py run --name x49_4_anatomy_27b --layers 8 16 24 30 32 34 40 48 56 --why "batch 49, test 49.4 (jobs/c3/batch49.yaml; 47.8's arms and rules, Q47.8, sealed): the 27B's layer anatomy, reduced grid L8-L56 every 8th plus L30, L32, L34, 150 test scenes"
question: As depth increases, what does a change at the bridge word move, and through which part: the lens-readable identity (the J++ part), the identity outside the lens (I_l), the address (U_l), or nothing? Does the lookup stop needing the lens part before or when it starts using the address (handoff), does the address form before it is used, does the identity leave the lens by L, and is the value never taken at any depth?
why_it_matters: The coarse version (Fig 6: 4-5 layers, J++ and position only) left the depth picture a candidate: Q35.1 held on the 9B and failed on the 27B by about 4 layers. One sweep with every part, both readers and the probes shows the around route forming layer by layer and turns Fig 6's "after the data" readings into the rule-based readings (a)-(d). The cached fit-half states and per-layer refits also feed D4 (address persistence, lens identity vs the embedding, the cross-track alignment table) on the CPU.

hypotheses.Q47.8: Dan's answer in predictions/2026-10-28_dan.md (Q47.8); not committed when this spec was written, so the run is sealed: no verdict in the job (scripts/x47_anatomy.py verdict / view / figures refuse until it is committed).

decision_rule: Fixed in advance (jobs/c3/batch47.yaml, 47.8; per model, the rest descriptive). l_J = the first layer from which the lookup's extra loss without J++ stays <= 0.10; l_P = the first layer where the position share under the whole change is >= 0.20; l_probe = the first layer where the slot probe is >= 0.80. (a) Handoff: l_P >= l_J, report l_P - l_J (Q35.1's failure on the 27B predicts a gap of about 4 layers there). (b) The address forms before it is used: l_probe <= l_P on every model; if the probe reaches 0.80 only after l_P, say so. (c) Identity leaves the lens: identity share with only-J++ >= 0.5 at the earliest interpretable layer and <= 0.1 by L, while identity with only-I_l rises to >= 0.3 by L, on >= 2 of 3 models; report the crossing layer. (d) Never the value, at any depth: value <= 0.05 at every interpretable layer. (e) The recall side: the layer window where the whole change switches the recall >= 0.5, and whether without-J++ costs it >= 0.3 throughout that window (the recall's own onset layer reported beside l_J). 'Not interpretable' where the whole change switches < 30% of a reader. As computed (fixed by the agent before any run; Dan may override before the run): Scenes: x6_routes' generator (seed 2510; locker-first), conditions C2 and C0, X0's gate (0.80 per reader on unedited scenes) and eligibility; the eligible C2 scenes split by bridge entity (seed 0; entities in a seeded order fill the test half to N_TEST scenes, the rest form the fit half, >= 150 or the run stops). Per sweep layer, from one forward of O and of S per scene: on the fit half the layout-free slot means and U_l (mass-mean basis; rank 2 with three lockers, the spec's rank 4 is not reachable here), the entity means over O and S bridge-word states and Id_l, x0_probe's three probes (entities held out), the refit's held-out slot / entity accuracy on the test half, the lens's top-10 rate for the bridge token; on the test half Delta = h_S - h_O and its parts J (signed OMP, 25 atoms of the layer's J++ lens, letter tokens), U (projection on U_l), I (rank-1 along mu_S - mu_O orthogonalised against the scene's atoms; zero where an entity has no mean, the scene left out of the I cells), W_E's 25-atom part and its overlap with J (D4). Random parts of the same share per scene: random lens atoms (seed 777 + l) for J, X0's random subspace (seed 888 + l) for U and I. Arms: none, whole, keep_X, keep_X_rand, no_X, no_X_rand for X in J, U, I; C0 scenes none and whole. Reads: X0's chat read, both readers; lookup answers classified identity / position / value / original / other, recall answers changed / original / slot item / other. Verdict (CPU, after Q47.8): per model and layer, shares and extra losses (X.cell) with cluster-bootstrap CIs over bridge entities (10,000, seed 0); the lookup's switch = identity + position + value, the recall's = changed; not interpretable where the whole change switches < 0.30; l_J, l_P, l_probe and rules (a)-(e) as the spec words them, point estimates, EPS 1e-9. C0 check at L: the whole change's lookup switch within 0.10 of the one-pick reference (Muse: >= 0.5), else the job fails after writing its files.
controls: every keep-only and without arm paired with a random part of the same share of the change per scene: random lens atoms (seed 777 + layer) for the J++ part, X0's random subspace (seed 888 + layer) for U_l and I_l; the achieved random shares recorded per scene (norms.jsonl)

the sanity swap C0 (Iris picks the other item, nothing moves) read under the whole change at every layer; at L its lookup switch rate must be within 0.10 of the one-pick reference (Muse: >= 0.5), else the job fails after writing its files

the fit half and the test half share no bridge entity (split.json); the refits' held-out slot / entity accuracy on the test half and the lens's top-10 rate per layer are reported beside the arms (dumbest ways 1 and 3)
none (O unedited) read beside every arm; layers where the whole change switches < 30% of a reader are shaded and not read (dumbest way 2)
the recall reader on the same scenes and arms: changed item / original item / the item at the target slot / other
n: 150 test scenes (C2, another item moved) and their C0 base scenes; the fit half every other eligible C2 scene up to 250 (at least 150, else the run stops); plan on the 9B tokenizer (28 Oct): 700 C2 scenes generated, 32 bridge entities (10 to the test half, 22 to the fit half when all are eligible); x6_routes' eligibility on the 9B was 573 of 700
notes: Speedup-box copy of x49_4_27b_h (28 Oct ~16:45: helper had ~2.4 GPU-h queued, speedup idle; one id, one box; run name unchanged). Batch 49 test 49.4 (Dan 28 Oct brief; queue item 10 in amendment 1): x47_8_27b with the reduced grid passed by --layers (9 of 15 layers; 150 scenes as before); est 1.8 x 9/15 = 1.1 GPU-h by 47.8's own estimate, Dan's 1.5 kept. Read beside the 9B and Muse (47.8): a position window at all? identity in the lens longer? Batch 47 amendment 2 (Dan, 28 Oct ~02:40); batch47.yaml amendment 3 queue order: after 48.1 (Muse), before D1 (27B); after the freeze unless the queue is ahead. SEALED: the job runs `run` only and writes manifest, competence, gate, split, cases, fit.json (probes, held-out accuracies, lens top-10, median shares per layer), norms.jsonl (per scene and layer: shares, random shares, atoms, the W_E-25 / J++-25 overlaps, the J++ share of U_l and of the identity direction), outcomes.jsonl, 10 items' greedy texts at L, c0_check.json and cache/ (fit_states.npz: the fit half's O and S bridge-word states at every sweep layer fp16 and the locker sentences' item and number tokens every 8th layer for the first 160 fit scenes; bases.npz: U_l, Id_l, slot / entity / layout means per layer) for D4. After Dan's Q47.8 is committed, by hand (CPU): uv run python scripts/x47_anatomy.py verdict (the three runs: qwen35_9b_x47_anatomy x47_anatomy_27b muse30_x47_anatomy), view (10 random test items, seed 0: O and S contexts, every arm's answer at L, the whole change by layer), figures --verdict <its folder>. Seeds: 0 the split, the bootstrap and the examples; 777 + layer the random lens atoms; 888 + layer the random subspace; 2510 the scenes. GPU estimate: per-layer rows: 1 + 15 x 13 = 196 per scene and reader; 150 x 2 x 196 = 58,800 rows + C0 150 x 2 x 16 = 4,800 rows = 63,600 rows in 600 + 300 read calls; forwards: fit 250 x 2 + test 150 x 2 + C0 150 x 2 = 1,100 recording 15 layers. The 27B's x45e_27b_dom (580 cases) took 1922 s against the 9B's 1008 s: 1.9x the 9B's per-call costs. Sum: forwards 1,100 x 0.5 = 550 s; test reads 600 x 1.9 = 1,140 s; C0 reads 300 x 0.6 = 180 s; competence 760 s; per-layer fits ~40 s x 15 = 600 s; setup 30 s: ~3,260 s = 0.9 h, rounded up to 1.8 (Dan's estimate 3; the 27B's 64 layers make the recording forwards the slowest). Cache size on this model: about 75 MB of states (250 x 15 x 5120 x fp16 x 2) + 80 MB of locker tokens; if that is too much for results/, cut N_LOCKER or LOCKER_STEP in scripts/x47_anatomy.py before enqueue.

title: Batch 50 Z2 on the 27B L32: our change-removal on Zach's jsuite v2 passages, never-named bridge (M start, the bridge only described in the question). The question describes another entity of the passage; Delta = h_S - h_O at the description's last token, per reader (K = lookup, M = recall); whole / without J++ / without a random part of its share; description competence step (47.3's); sealed
command: BJ_TARGET=qwen3.6-27b BJ_DEVICE_MAP= uv run python scripts/x50_zach.py run --part z2 --name x50_z2_27b
question: When the bridge is never named and must be computed from a description in the question ("the country that is home to Machu Picchu"), does the lookup of the computed bridge (K final) still go around the J++ part of the change at the description's last token while the recall (M final) needs it, or is the computed bridge handed through the lens?
why_it_matters: The one that matters most (batch 50): his swap site, three operations on one site (his swap: sufficient; his erase: not necessary; our removal from the change, followed in a conflict). Our 47.3 said 9B / Muse (a), 27B (a'); if his passages agree, the 27B's lens-leaning lookup is a model property, not a scene artefact.

hypotheses.Q50.2: Dan's answer in predictions/2026-10-28_dan.md (Q50.2); not committed when this spec was written, so the run is sealed: no verdict in the job (scripts/x50_zach.py verdict refuses until the answer is committed).

decision_rule: Fixed in advance (jobs/c3/batch50.yaml, Z2, verbatim): per model, the 47.3 rule: (a) the split holds: gap >= 0.3, lookup <= 0.10; (a') the computed bridge is handed through the lens: lookup >= 0.20; (d) in between. As computed (fixed before any run; Dan may override before it). Items: v3 is not on the box, so Zach's v2 facts module, jsuite_v2_test_chat (seed 2601, his main set), and jsuite_v2nb_test_chat (his second seed) when fewer than 200 passages are eligible on the main set (expected: the main set alone cannot reach 200). A passage = one of his M-start scenes: its MK item (every entity's true fact stated, the bridge named only in a neutral or fact sentence, never in the question: our lookup, reader K) and its MM item (the bridge's fact not stated: our recall, reader M), same question (the bridge described) and answer. Leak filter: a description holding O's or S's answer or a derived word (jsuite_v2_tables.DERIV) is dropped (none of v2's 361 descriptions does). S: the question describes another entity of the passage (true fact stated in the K passage, another answer) by one of its v2 descriptions, the description ending at the same token index (only the description's tokens change); the options in a seeded order per scene (seed 5001). Plan check on the Qwen tokenizer: 110 of 358 passages with an aligned option (137 options, 120 descriptions); second seed 130 more. Competence step (47.3's), inside the job and recorded: per description 10 prompts (5 wordings: his hop-1 question, "Which <noun> is <d>?", "Name <d>.", "What is the name of <d>?", "I am thinking of <d>. Which <noun> is it?"; x 2 instructions; no passage; 12 greedy tokens); kept if the reply's first line names the entity (or a v2 alt name) in >= 0.90; a passage needs O's description kept and takes its first option whose description is kept. The read: his chat framing, the top token against the answer's first token; switch = the other entity's answer. Gate: O's read accuracy >= 0.80 per reader over every passage past the competence step; eligible: both readers say and read O's and S's answers right; the first 200 in passage order. The reads run whatever the gate says; a failed gate is "not tested" in the verdict (the gate over Zach's competence-kept passages beside). Delta = h_S - h_O at the description's last token at L32, per reader, added on O. Arms: whole; without J++ (signed OMP, k = 25, the letter-token J++ atoms at L, the pinned lens); without a random part of its share (X0's random subspace, seed 888 + L). Extra loss = X0's excess; gap = M's minus K's on the same cluster-bootstrap draws (bridge entity, 10,000, seed 0). Point estimates decide (EPS 1e-9); an undefined extra loss holds no clause. Scored by hand: scripts/x50_zach.py verdict --part z2.
controls: the J++ part against a random part of its own share (X0's random subspace, seed 888 + L)
the recall (M) on the same passage and the same counterfactual (the gap)
the description competence step (>= 0.90 per description) and the read gate (0.80 per reader)

beside: Zach's stored per-item J++ top-10 knock-out at L32-40 on the same passages, all positions and question-only (his nearest stored erase at the description), joined by item id; results/ablate_v2/jsuite_v2_test_chat_ko_cand2_v1 and its _posquestion_v1; no M-start swap rows exist (jswap covers P and T starts), no rerun
n: up to 200 eligible passages (110 + 130 aligned passages before the competence step): the job will likely end below 200
notes: Speedup-box copy of x50_z2_27b (28 Oct ~16:45: speedup idle, mats busy; one id, one box; run name unchanged). Sealed: the run writes manifest, desc_competence, cases, competence, gate.json, outcomes, norms; no verdict. By hand after Dan's Q50.2 is committed (CPU): uv run python scripts/x50_zach.py verdict --part z2 (the table, the verify-pack view of 10 random passages, seed 0, and the figure beside his knock-out). Seeds: 2601 his set, 5001 the option order per scene, 0 the bootstrap and the view, 888 + L the random subspace. Plan: results/x50_zach/plan-20261028T150904Z/. Estimate: x47_3_27b (700 short competence scenes, 300 read scenes, 8 arms) took 829 s on one H100; this job has ~2,500 description prompts (12 tokens, batched by length), up to 240 passages of ~350 tokens through the competence step, 800 forwards for the change and 200 x 2 readers x 4 rows of reads: about 0.15 h with the model load; 0.3 with margin (Dan: ~0.8 GPU-h).
